headline: Romanian entrepreneurs pessimistic: 81.4% say the business environment deteriorated in 2026
summary: A survey by IMM Romania found 81.4% of entrepreneurs say the business environment deteriorated in 2026. More than half expect economic activity to decline over the next six months.
why: Business sentiment surveys are leading indicators of investment and hiring decisions, which feed into the outlook for Romania's economy.
